mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.name_kor, h.name_eng, h.ctp_id, c.name AS ctp_name, c.color FROM HERO h LEFT JOIN CTP c ON h.ctp_id = c.id WHERE h.name_kor LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR h.name_eng LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT id, name FROM CTP ORDER BY name
SELECT COALESCE(g.group_idx, h.id) AS group_idx FROM HERO h LEFT JOIN HERO_GROUP g ON h.id = g.hero_idx WHERE h.id = #{heroId}
